auth.title: Sign in
auth.description: Use the account your administrator gave you.
auth.invalid: The email or password is wrong, or the account is disabled.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.comingTitle: The dashboard is on its way
dashboard.comingBody: Booking, session, and finance figures will appear here once those parts are built.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Find, add, and update customer details.
customers.createDescription: The customer code is generated automatically.
customers.searchPlaceholder: Search by code, name, or phone
customers.emptyBody: Add your first customer to get started.

users.title: Users
users.createDescription: The user signs in with this email and initial password.
users.resetPasswordDescription: The user is signed out on every device.
users.disableBody: They're signed out right away and can't sign in until they're enabled again.

overrides.description: Switch single permissions on or off for this person only; the rest follow the role {role}.

accessHours.description: The user can sign in and work only in these windows (gym time). No windows: any time.
accessHours.none: Not limited: they can sign in at any time.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to this page
forbidden.body: Ask an administrator if you need access.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: The page or record you're looking for doesn't exist.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details aren't valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_USED: That email is already used by another account.
errors.CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ACCESS: You cannot change your own access.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: The request body must be JSON.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED: The request is missing its duplicate-submission key. Reload the page and try again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This request was already sent with different content. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: That action isn't possible in the current status.
errors.CONTRACT_NOT_EDITABLE: Only draft contracts can be edited.
errors.CONTRACT_NOT_ACTIVE: The contract isn't active: it's a draft, cancelled, or expired.
errors.CONTRACT_NO_REMAINING_SESSIONS: The contract has no sessions left for this.
errors.CONTRACT_HAS_CHECKED_IN_BOOKING: A session of this contract is checked in. Complete or cancel it first.
errors.BOOKING_TRAINER_OVERLAP: The trainer already has a booking at that time.
errors.BOOKING_CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_MISMATCH: That contract belongs to a different customer.
errors.BOOKING_OUTSIDE_CONTRACT_PERIOD: The session date is outside the contract's start and end dates.
errors.PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_CONTRACT_VALUE: This payment would make the paid amount exceed the contract value.
errors.PAYMENT_CONTRACT_CANCELLED: Payments can't be recorded on a cancelled contract.

validation.invalidDate: Enter a valid date as dd/mm/yyyy.
validation.invalidCharacters: Contains characters that are not allowed.
validation.invalidAmount: Enter a whole amount in đồng, for example 12,000,000.
validation.invalidNumber: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1000.
validation.endBeforeStart: The end date must be on or after the start date.
validation.invalidTime: Enter a time as hh:mm, for example 18:30.
validation.endTimeNotAfterStart: The end time must be after the start time.
validation.invalidChoice: Choose an option from the list.
validation.trainerUnavailable: This trainer isn't taking new bookings.
validation.userNotTrainer: Only logins whose role sees only its own schedule (such as PT) can be linked.
validation.userAlreadyLinked: This login is already linked to another trainer.
validation.futureDate: The date can't be later than today.
validation.otherAlwaysActive: "Other" is always in use and cannot be switched off.
validation.notOnHalfHour: Use a full or half hour, for example 05:00 or 05:30.
validation.invalidCodePrefix: Use 1 to 5 letters without accents, for example KH.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.createDescription: New contracts start as drafts. The contract code is generated automatically.
contracts.editDescription: Only draft contracts can be edited.
contracts.activateBody: The contract takes effect. After activation, its package, value, sessions, and dates can't be edited.
contracts.cancelBody: The contract can't be used anymore, and its upcoming bookings are cancelled too. This can't be undone.
contracts.searchPlaceholder: Search by contract code, package, or customer
contracts.emptyBody: Create a contract from a customer's page.
contracts.cancelBookingsList: {count, plural, one {This booking will be cancelled:} other {These # bookings will be cancelled:}}
contracts.sessionHistoryEmpty: No sessions booked on this contract yet

trainers.title: Trainers
trainers.createDescription: The trainer code is generated automatically.
trainers.editDescription: An inactive trainer takes no new bookings; existing bookings stay.
trainers.emptyBody: Add trainers so customers can book sessions with them.
trainers.loginDescription: A login with the Trainer role. Once linked, the trainer can see and run their own sessions.

bookings.calendarDescription: Bookings by trainer for one day.
bookings.sessionsDescription: Today's and upcoming sessions, check-ins, and results.
bookings.createDescription: Booking doesn't use a session. A session is used only when it's completed.
bookings.rescheduleDescription: Choose a new trainer or time.
bookings.completeBody: This uses one session of contract {code}. Remaining sessions: {from} → {to}.
bookings.cancelBody: The booking is cancelled and the trainer's time is freed. No session is used.
bookings.cancelCheckedInBody: The customer is already checked in. Cancelling now is an exception: no session is used, and it can't be undone.
bookings.noShowBody: The customer didn't come. No session is used, and the trainer's time is freed.
bookings.customerSearchPlaceholder: Search by code, name, or phone
bookings.noBookableContracts: This customer has no active contract with sessions left.
bookings.noTrainersBody: A manager needs to add trainers before sessions can be booked.
bookings.trainerNotLinkedTitle: Your login isn't linked to a trainer
bookings.trainerNotLinkedBody: Ask a manager to link your login so you can see your schedule.

finance.title: Finance
finance.description: Contract payments, debt, income, and expenses.
finance.summaryNote: Contract payments and other income are shown separately until the accounting treatment is decided.
finance.debtDescription: Contracts that still owe money, largest first. Drafts are not included.
finance.cashEmpty: No income or expenses this month
finance.recordPaymentDescription: {debt} outstanding. The payment is confirmed when saved.
finance.recordCashDescription: To correct an entry, void it and record a new one.
finance.voidPaymentBody: It stops counting toward the paid amount but stays on record. It can't be reinstated.
finance.voidCashBody: It stops counting in the totals but stays on record. Record a new entry if it needs correcting.

booking.view: View the PT calendar and sessions

cash.manage: Other income and expenses (view, record, void)

config.manage: Manage option lists and system parameters

receipts.totals: Totals on receipt and expense lists

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.description: A role is a set of permissions, data scopes, and hidden fields. Changes apply at once to everyone with the role.
roles.createDescription: Name it, then choose permissions, data scopes, and hidden fields.
roles.cloneDescription: The new role gets the same permissions, scopes, and hidden fields; adjust it afterwards.

fields.name: Role name
fields.dataScopesHint: "Only their own": customers they created or train, their contracts, sessions they teach, vouchers they entered.
fields.fieldMasksHint: Hidden on every screen, and not searchable.

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Every customer, contract, session, and voucher belongs to a branch. An inactive branch takes no new records.

options.title: Option lists
options.description: The drop-down lists used across the system. An option no longer in use cannot be chosen but stays on old records. "Other" is always last and needs a note.
options.empty: This list has no options yet besides "Other".

otherNotes.title: Notes written with "Other"
otherNotes.description: Notes that come up often are worth adding as options of their own.
otherNotes.empty: Nobody has chosen "Other" in this list yet.

parameters.title: System parameters
parameters.description: Values the system uses every day. Changes apply at once and are kept in the history.
parameters.calendarHint: First and last time on the PT calendar. Sessions outside them are still shown.
parameters.codesHint: The prefix comes before the number. Numbers never repeat, even after the prefix changes.
